title: The Meridian Logistics rate-sheet incident
briefing: An operations account at Meridian Logistics was used on Thursday morning to ask a haulage partner to change its bank details. The account holder says they did nothing unusual. You have the mailbox and Thursday's security logs. More than one message here is hostile, and one of them is a convincing reply to a conversation that really happened.

emails.subject: Re: October capacity plan
emails.bodyText: Numbers look workable for October. I would keep one spare vehicle at depot two rather than depot four, given the roadworks. Happy to walk through it on Friday.

emails.subject: Depot 4 gate code changes on Monday
emails.bodyText: The depot four gate code changes on Monday morning. Supervisors can collect the new code in person from the site office with their pass. It will not be sent by email.

emails.subject: Your parcel could not be delivered
emails.bodyText: We attempted delivery of your parcel today and nobody was available. Arrange redelivery within three days or the parcel returns to the sender. A small redelivery fee applies.

emails.subject: Q3 carrier rates - updated sheet
emails.bodyText: Sharing the updated carrier rates ahead of Friday. The third tab has the comparison Olu asked for. Please review the northern routes in particular, they moved more than expected.

emails.subject: Invoice 88120 for August haulage
emails.bodyText: Please find our invoice for August haulage. Payment terms are unchanged at thirty days. Our bank details are as held on your supplier record and have not changed.

emails.subject: Monthly safety briefing - September
emails.bodyText: September's briefing covers reversing assistants and load securing. Toolbox talks run at both depots on Wednesday and attendance is recorded by your supervisor.

emails.subject: RE: Depot 4 gate code changes on Monday
emails.bodyText: Noted. I will collect the code on Monday morning and brief the early shift. Can we keep the old code active until midday for the agency drivers?

emails.subject: Payment run moves to Thursday this week
emails.bodyText: This week's payment run moves to Thursday afternoon. Any supplier bank detail change must be verified by telephone against the number on the supplier record, never a number supplied in an email.

emails.subject: RE: Q3 carrier rates - updated sheet
emails.bodyText: Sorry, the version I sent yesterday had the northern routes wrong. I have put the corrected sheet on the document portal because the file was too large for email. You will need to sign in with your work account to open it. Please check it before the Friday review.

emails.subject: Scheduled VPN maintenance on Sunday
emails.bodyText: Remote access will be unavailable on Sunday between 6am and 8am while we apply updates. No action is needed and you do not need to re-enter any credentials.

emails.subject: Annual leave balances before year end
emails.bodyText: Remaining leave balances are now visible in the self-service tile. Up to five days may be carried over, and anything above that lapses at the end of December.

emails.subject: RE: Invoice 88120 - updated remittance advice
emails.bodyText: Further to invoice 88120, our banking has moved to a new provider this month. Please use the revised account below for this and all future payments and confirm once your records are updated.

emails.subject: Driver roster - week 39
emails.bodyText: The week 39 roster is published. Two agency drivers cover the northern routes on Tuesday and Wednesday. Swaps need supervisor approval by Friday noon.

emails.subject: Security alert: sign-in from a new device
emails.bodyText: A sign-in to your account was recorded from a device we do not recognise. If this was you, no action is needed. If it was not, telephone the service desk on the internal number printed on your pass. Do not use a number from an email.

emails.subject: Lunch and learn on Friday - route optimisation
emails.bodyText: Friday's lunch and learn covers route optimisation with the planning team. Lunch is provided and the session is recorded for anyone on shift.

emails.subject: Urgent: a shared document is awaiting your review
emails.bodyText: A document has been shared with you and is awaiting review. Access expires in 24 hours. Sign in with your email provider to view the file before it is withdrawn.

emails.subject: Re: October capacity plan numbers
emails.bodyText: Agreed on keeping the spare at depot two. I will update the plan before Friday so we are all looking at the same version in the review.

emails.subject: Head office closes early on 30 September
emails.bodyText: Head office closes at 3pm on 30 September for building maintenance. Depot operations continue as normal and the out-of-hours number is unchanged.

emails.subject: Fuel card renewal for your fleet
emails.bodyText: Your fuel cards are due for renewal in November. Your account manager will call to confirm the card list. No changes are needed from you at this stage.

emails.subject: RE: Payment run moves to Thursday this week
emails.bodyText: To confirm, the run completed this afternoon. One supplier change request was held for telephone verification and has not been paid. We will confirm tomorrow.

timeline.label: Mail gateway - outbound message
timeline.detail: A message was sent from o.baptiste's account to Calder Freight asking them to update Meridian's bank details for future remittances.

evidenceOptions.label: The sender's address adds an extra suffix to the company domain, which makes it a different registered domain
That message's portal host was opened at 08:47 and the sign-in from an unrecognised device followed at 09:12
The subject line matches a genuine internal conversation from the previous day
A shared document notice was delivered with a suspicious-sender warning
A colleague opened a parcel redelivery link on Wednesday afternoon
The message carried a password-protected archive attachment
